about: The Knight (the Duelist's 1.0 ascendancy) as poe2db's Knight page shows it (read 24 Nov 2026; every line '1.0 preview, subject to change'). NOT allocatable yet: the Duelist class and its tree start aren't in the 0.5.5 tree or PoB (builder/preview/PLAN.md: Shadow / Duelist starts wait for the 1.0 tree), so no search can take these nodes; this file holds them ready, each line with how the tool would read it (pob_text: the line as PoB's parser is asked to read it; model: what PoB can't). The page showed 7 minor / notable pairs on 24 Nov, two more than RESEARCH53's 10 nodes of 23 Nov; the two extra pairs have names in Chinese on the page and garbled English (machine translation): their text is LOW. Point costs and links are not shown (checked: the Knight page; R53's GGG-A). Release day: replace with the 1.0 tree's nodes (PLAN.md).
source: https://poe2db.tw/us/Knight (read 24 Nov 2026: 'New Duelist Ascendancy: Knight'; node lines near-verbatim); RESEARCH53 R53-1 section A (23 Nov, the 10 nodes)
